ACT IV OF 1989
ACT IV OF 1989
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
An Act further to
amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th January, 1989]
No.Legis.2(9)/88/4, dated
14-1-1989.--The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1988 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 24th day of December,
1988 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 9th day of January,
1989, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Local Government
(Amendment) Act, 1988.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have come into effect on the first day of December,
1988.

Amendment of section 12 of Punjab Ordinance VI of 1979

No.Legis.2(9)/88/4, dated
14-1-1989.--The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1988 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 24th day of December,
1988 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 9th day of January,
1989, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 12 of
Punjab Ordinance VI of 1979.--In the Punjab Local Government Ordinance,
1979 (Punjab Ordinance VI of 1979), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 12, in subsection (2), the first Proviso and the word
"further" in the second Proviso shall be omitted.
